summary:
ARIA — Earth Sonification System is an interactive web-based platform that transforms environmental and climate data into visual and audio experiences. It features an interactive 3D Earth, allowing users to explore environmental indicators, geographical regions and changes over time. Through sonification, scientific measurements are mapped to sound properties such as pitch, tempo and stereo position, helping users experience patterns beyond traditional charts and graphs.

ARIA addresses the challenge of making complex Earth data easier to understand and more accessible by combining visualization with sound. It aims to provide an additional way for people, including users with visual impairments, to explore environmental changes. Open scientific data and technologies from NASA, along with relevant NOAA datasets, can support the platform with information about temperature, atmosphere, oceans and other Earth systems.

ARIA is important because understanding our planet's changing environment should be engaging, inclusive and accessible. It turns scientific information into an experience people can both see and hear.
details:
ARIA — Earth Sonification System

ARIA is an interactive web-based Earth observatory that transforms scientific environmental and climate data into visual and audio experiences. It allows users to explore different regions of Earth, select environmental data channels, navigate historical timelines from 1980 to 2025, and listen to changes through real-time browser-based sound synthesis.

The platform uses open scientific data from NASA, NOAA and other research organizations. Its data sources include NASA GISTEMP for global temperature anomalies, NASA POWER for regional meteorological information, NASA GIBS for satellite imagery, NOAA measurements for atmospheric CO₂ and methane, and satellite-altimetry data for sea-level changes. The website also identifies forest and cryosphere indicators as empirical benchmarks rather than direct live data feeds.

ARIA's main benefit is making complex scientific information more engaging and accessible. Through sonification, measurements are mapped to sound properties such as pitch, tempo, resonance and stereo positioning. This provides another way to recognize environmental patterns, including for people who may have difficulty interpreting visual charts.

We developed ARIA using HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Three.js, Python and FastAPI, along with Web Audio API technology for sound generation. The project combines interactive mapping, scientific data processing and creative audio design in one platform.

Its creativity lies in turning environmental measurements into an experience that users can both see and hear. During development, we considered scientific accuracy, data transparency, accessibility, usability, performance and the distinction between real scientific observations and empirical or simulated information.

Our intended impact is to make understanding Earth's changing environment more interactive, inclusive and engaging, encouraging greater awareness of climate change and the importance of protecting our planet.
